NOTE
**Still not ready — design question settled, but the PR itself hasn't changed**

New: Daniel K said on CZO that this extends the filters from #24200, so the design hold is lifted. There has been no new push since the feedback. Missing: the description still has a malformed "Fixes #<36878>", so the issue isn't linked. The two "ci: retry" commits are noise, and the large change isn't split into coherent commits.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't add "maintainer review" yet; karlstolley, who gave the feedback, can re-check once the author pushes the cleanup.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for checking with Daniel, so the design question is settled. Before review, please fix the description to use `Fixes: #36878` and follow the [PR guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html), and squash the "ci: retry" commits into proper, coherent commits per the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
